value.title: 1500s (decade)
value.snippet: The 1500s ran from January 1, 1500, to December 31, 1509. January 5 – Duke Ludovico Sforza recaptures Milan, but is soon driven out again by the French

value.title: Action of 12–17 January 1640
value.snippet: successfully landed at the Lagunas under General Luis de Rojas. The Dutch vessels in the area were driven off and de Hoces spent some months escorting a sugar convoy
